boundary.description: From the confluence of Manchester Ship Canal and Bridgewater Canal (Stretford and Leigh Branch), E along Manchester Ship Canal to and S along Old Trafford Road to Bridgewater Canal Towpath. Then W by the Bridgewater Canal Towpath to its confluence with Bridgewater Canal Stretford and Leigh Branch and by that canal to Manchester Ship Canal.
